notes: All 3 photos were the same printed dinner menu shot from different angles/crops (1 and 2 overlap on Soups/Entree Salad, merged); prices and descriptions are sharp and fully legible.

dishes.name: Surf & Turf
dishes.description: 12 oz. Ribeye and 8 oz. lobster tail

dishes.name: Alaskan Halibut & Chips
dishes.description: The finest fish & chips in San Diego County.

dishes.name: Pacific Crab Cakes & Fries
dishes.description: Made with fresh California Dungeness crab meat.

dishes.name: Maine Lobster Roll & Chips
dishes.description: Lobster salad made with fresh dill and a little mayo on a butter-toasted French roll. Served with house-made potato chips.

dishes.name: Shrimp & Lobster Carbonara
dishes.description: Lobster, Shrimp, chopped bacon and portobello mushrooms in a Parmesan cream sauce over pasta.

dishes.name: Black Angus 1/2 lb. Burger, Grilled Chicken or Veggie Burger
dishes.description: Fully dressed on a toasted sesame seed bun.

dishes.name: Clam Chowder, Seafood Gumbo or Mom's Chicken Vegetable Soup
Ahi or Chicken Salad
dishes.description: On a bed of greens served with avocado & tomato.

dishes.name: Voodoo "BBQ" Shrimp
dishes.description: In New Orleans, barbecue shrimp means sautéed shrimp in a black pepper, garlicky, herbed butter sauce. We serve these extra large Louisiana shrimp with heads and tails on. A bib is highly recommended.

dishes.name: Po' Boys & Fries
dishes.description: A traditional Louisiana-style fried seafood sub, served fully dressed on a freshly-baked French roll. Choose Shrimp, Oyster, Soft Shell Crab or Blackened Catfish.

dishes.name: Blackened Catfish
dishes.description: Catfish fillets spiced with Cajun seasonings and seared in a hot cast iron skillet. Served with cheese grits and finished with our Pontchartrain crab sauce.

dishes.name: Jambalaya
dishes.description: A creole rice dish cooked with shrimp, chicken, sausage and the Louisiana trinity of onion, bell pepper and celery.

dishes.name: Shrimp & Grits
dishes.description: Our classic low country recipe. Gruyere cheese grits topped with skewers of large Cajun-spiced shrimp sautéed with shallots and bacon bits.

dishes.name: Gumbo Deluxe
dishes.description: Originating in 18th century southern Louisiana, our gumbo is a collection of fragrant spices, savory meats, crab, shrimp and crawfish tails - with a dark, rich roux.
